'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russian occupation of Zaporizhzhia Oblast]]
****The [[Russia]]n-appointed head of [[Mykhailivka, Vasylivka Raion, Zaporizhzhia Oblast|Mykhailivka]] in [[Zaporizhzhia Oblast]], Ivan Sushko, is assassinated in a car bombing. [https://euroweeklynews.com/2022/08/24/russian-appointed-head-of-zaporizhzhia-ivan-sushko-killed-in-car-bomb-explosion/ (Euro Weekly News)]
***[[Chaplyne railway station attack]]
****At least 25 people are killed and more than 50 others are injured in a Russian [[Chaplyne railway station attack|rocket attack]] on a passenger train in [[Chaplyne]], [[Dnipropetrovsk Oblast]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/aug/24/at-least-15-killed-in-russian-strike-on-rail-station-on-ukraines-independence-day (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/least-15-died-russian-attack-ukraine-station-zelenskiy-2022-08-24/ (Reuters)]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Foreign aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***The [[United States]] announces a security package of nearly {{US$|3|long=no|link=yes}} billion from the [[Ukraine Security Assistance Initiative]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/ukraine-aid-3-billion-biden-administration-announcement/ (CBS News)]
*[[American-led intervention in the Syrian civil war]], [[Russia–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] orders airstrikes against claimed [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] and Russia-linked groups in [[Syria]] in response to a August 15 rocket attack near the [[Al-Tanf (U.S. military base)|U.S. military base in al-Tanf]], Syria, which houses the [[Maghaweir al-Thowra]] [[Syrian Opposition|rebel group]], and an airstrike by the [[Russian military]] in an area held by the [[Syrian opposition]]. The U.S. strikes targeted eleven bunkers in [[Deir ez-Zor Governorate|Deir ez-Zor]] used to store weapons, according to the [[United States Central Command]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/08/23/politics/syria-airstrikes-iranian-backed-groups-biden/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-military-carries-out-strike-syria-iran-linked-targets-2022-08-24/ (Reuters)]
**A spokesperson for the [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian foreign ministry]] denies that [[Iran]] has any link to targets hit by U.S. in Syria and condemns the strike as "a violation of Syria's sovereignty and territorial integrity". [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-denies-any-link-targets-hit-by-us-syria-2022-08-24/ (Reuters)] [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/syria-us-service-member-wounded-military-says (''Middle East Eye'')]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Eight people are killed in a shooting between two criminal groups in [[Tuzantla]], [[Michoacán]], [[Mexico]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-city-butterflies-097160ae675272ba1ffefec6d90f298e (AP)]
*[[Tigray War]]
**Fighting resumes between the [[Ethiopian National Defense Force|Ethiopian military]] and the [[Tigray Defense Forces]] in the [[Tigray Region]]. Both sides blame each other for breaking the ceasefire. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/aug/24/fighting-in-northern-ethiopia-shatters-months-long-truce-tigray (''The Guardian'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Hydrail]]
**[[Germany]] and French rail transport manufacturer [[Alstom]] inaugurate the world's first fleet of [[hydrogen fuel]]-powered trains in [[Lower Saxony]]. The 14 hydrogen trains will replace a fleet of diesel locomotives on {{conv|100|km|mi}} of track in the German state. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/8/24/germany-inaugurates-worlds-first-hydrogen-powered-train-fleet (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Tuvalu]] declares a [[drought]] and a shortage of drinking water on the islands of [[Nanumea]], [[Nui (atoll)|Nui]], and [[Niutao]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/473406/pacific-news-and-sport-in-brief-for-august-24 (RNZ)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Censorship in Russia]]
**Police arrest [[Kremlin]] critic [[Yevgeny Roizman]], the former mayor of [[Yekaterinburg]], for "discrediting the Russian army" by criticizing the invasion of [[Ukraine]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2022/08/24/Russian-politician-detained-for-criticizing-Ukraine-invasion (Al Arabiya)]
*Aftermath of the [[2020 Calabasas helicopter crash]]
**A [[Grand juries in the United States|United States grand jury]] awards former professional basketball player [[Kobe Bryant]]'s widow, [[Vanessa Bryant]], [[United States dollar|$]]16 million against the [[Los Angeles County, California|Los Angeles County]] [[Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department|sheriff's]] and [[Los Angeles County Fire Department|fire department]]s for releasing graphic photographs of the former player, their 13-year-old daughter, and the other victims of the helicopter crash. Another victim's widow receives $15 million. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2022/08/25/latest-stories/kobe-bryant-widow-awarded-16m-in-trial-over-crash-photos/1855960 (''The Manila Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Angolan general election]]
**[[Angola]]ns vote to elect their [[President of Angola|president]] in a tight race between incumbent [[leftist]] candidate [[João Lourenço]] and center-[[right-wing politics|right]] candidate [[Adalberto Costa Júnior]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-gb/news/world/angolans-to-vote-in-tight-race-that-could-affect-pro-russia-ties/ar-AA111mcX?ocid=EMMX (MSN)]
*The [[Constitutional Court of Thailand]] temporarily suspends [[Prayut Chan-o-cha]]'s [[Prime Minister of Thailand|premiership]] due to a case filed by [[Pheu Thai Party]] lawmakers over whether the eight-year term limit for premiership should also include Prayut's time as the leader of [[National Council for Peace and Order]]. [[Deputy Prime Minister of Thailand|Deputy Prime Minister]] [[Prawit Wongsuwan]] will take over the premiership while the case is being heard. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/thai-court-suspends-pm-prayuth-chan-ocha-official-duty-pending-result-term-limit-2022-08-24/ (Reuters)]
